default: Hit Points (HP) determine how much damage you can take. Higher HP classes (typically 10-12 HP) are more durable in combat, while lower HP classes (typically 6-8 HP) are more fragile.
Key Ability is the most important stat for your class. Make sure to boost it with your free ability improvements.
Spellcasting classes (see class_categories.spellcasters: wizard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, bard, oracle, witch) can cast powerful spells but tend to have lower HP.
Martial classes (see class_categories.martial: fighter, barbarian, ranger, monk, champion, swashbuckler) excel in physical combat with weapons.
Skill specialists (see class_categories.skill_specialists: rogue, investigator, alchemist) focus on skills, expertise, and versatility with exceptional numbers of trained skills and unique abilities.
Consider your party composition - balanced parties with different roles tend to handle challenges better.
